title: 42083 Bugatti Chiron — community CAD reference
sourceLicense: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0, as stated in the source model headers.
changes: Packed the community model and its geometry dependencies for local loading.
Normalized MPD filenames and references to lowercase slash paths.
Indexed physical part instances with stable IDs; the separately listed official geometry corrections replace documented source substitutions and omissions.
Counted each source-generated shock, flexible hose, axle, rubber band and string as one physical part.
Grouped three-component universal joint geometry into physical 61903 assemblies, preserving every component transform.
Omitted three separately licensed non-commercial LDCad snapping metadata blocks; see omittedMetadata. Geometry commands are unchanged by this omission.
limitations: Community reconstruction; the supplied LEGO booklets remain the authoritative instructions.
The author states that source STEP groups do not strictly follow the official stepping.
The author identifies omitted stickers as a known source limitation.
Some source print decorations are omitted; these differences are listed in the catalog crosswalk.

The corrected CAD and official assembly callouts contain 3,590 physical pieces. The printed inventory lists 3,598 and the product page publishes 3,599; the differences remain explicitly documented in the illustrated inventory.

omittedMetadata.author: Roland Melkert [roland]
omittedMetadata.description: Three complete appended LDCad snapping-metadata works were omitted from both distributed MPDs. The site does not use these metadata. Their associated metadata author/license lines were removed with those works; all geometry and remaining author/license notices are unchanged by this omission. The upstream original remains linked by modelSource and identified by sourceSha256; source-model.mpd is now the redistributed copy identified by distributedSourceSha256.
